PLAN "12-Week Integrated Strength, Cardio, Nutrition & Recovery (Meniscus Safe, Ski Return, Peak)"
TYPE integrated
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

    name "Strength, challenging cardio, recovery, nutrition, safe ski return, peak in week 12"

          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
